question: Which three-syllabled form of Camunda is invoked to protect the heart?
premises: protection of the heart is requested
Camunda is identified as three-syllabled with krīṃ-hūṃ-hrīṃ
inference: the three-syllabled Camunda of krīṃ-hūṃ-hrīṃ protects the heart
uncertainties: internal structure of the fused mantra token krīhū/hrī/ follows the given surface
plain_english: May the three-syllabled Camunda, krīṃ-hūṃ-hrīṃ, protect my heart.
